help.title: Help
help.subtitle: A short guide to each part of EduVibe.
help.more: If anything is unclear or not working, please contact the EduVibe support team.
help.start.title: Getting started
help.start.1: Sign in with your phone number and the one-time password you were given.
help.start.2: Choose your own username and a new password. You use them from then on.
help.start.3: Add a venue, then your first class, then your students. The Home screen is your dashboard.
help.start.4: Your profile icon at the top holds Notifications: students who asked to join, unpaid fees and similar. A number on the icon means something is new.
help.start.5: On Home, tap Customise to choose which widgets show (today's classes, unpaid fees, students missing classes, exam progress) and to move them up or down. Your choice is saved to your account.
help.classes.title: Classes and timetable
help.classes.1: Open Venues and add the places you teach, such as your home or an institute.
help.classes.2: Open Classes, press Add class, and choose the subject, year, monthly fee and weekly times. EduVibe warns you if two classes overlap.
help.classes.3: Use Extra class for a session that is not on the weekly timetable, such as a revision class.
help.students.title: Students
help.students.1: Open Students and press Add student. Enter the phone number, name and class, and give the student the one-time password.
help.students.2: Or open a class and create a sign-up link. Students sign themselves up, and you approve them under Waiting for approval. Press Cancel link on the class screen to stop a link working at once.
help.students.3: A phone number belongs to one student. If it already exists, EduVibe offers to enrol that student in your class instead.
help.students.4: A student who has left keeps their history. Set them to Left instead of deleting them.
help.attendance.title: Attendance
help.attendance.1: Open Attendance and choose today's class.
help.attendance.2: Everyone starts present. Tap a student to mark absent, press and hold for late.
help.attendance.3: Press Save. You can change marks for 7 days afterwards.
help.attendance.4: Summary shows how often each student came. Export / Share saves it or sends it as a PDF, or as an Excel file.
help.fees.title: Fees
help.fees.1: Open Fees to see who has paid this month and who has not, with totals.
help.fees.2: Open a student and press Record a payment. A payment clears the oldest unpaid months first, or you can pick the months.
help.fees.3: Entered something wrongly? Void the payment and give a reason. It stays on the record.
help.fees.4: Attended, not paid lists students who came this month and still owe. Export / Share saves or sends the month's fee status as a PDF, or as an Excel file.
help.exams.title: Exams and marks
help.exams.1: Open Exams, press New exam, and set the class, date and parts with their maximum marks.
help.exams.2: Enter marks in the grid. Tick Absent for a student who did not sit, which is different from 0.
help.exams.3: Grades and ranks are worked out for you. Change the grade bands under Grading.
help.exams.4: Analysis shows the pass rate and averages. Publish results when you want students to see their own marks.
help.plan.title: Your plan
help.plan.1: Open Profile to see your plan, what it includes and how much of each limit you have used.
help.plan.2: If something is marked Available on Pro, contact the EduVibe support team about upgrading.

help.whatsapp.1: On Fees, open a class and press Remind on WhatsApp. Before anything is sent you see who will be messaged and who will not: no phone number, asked to stop, or already reminded this week.
help.whatsapp.2: On Attendance, open a saved class and press Tell parents of absent students. On Exams, publish the results, then press Send results on WhatsApp.
help.whatsapp.3: WhatsApp in the menu lists what you sent, whether it arrived, and how much of your monthly allowance is used. A parent can reply STOP to stop the messages.

help.cards.title: QR student cards
help.cards.1: Open a class, press the three dots, then Student cards. A card with a QR code is made for every student.
help.cards.2: Share or save the PDF and print it on A4. Cut out the cards and give one to each student.
help.cards.3: In Attendance, open the class and press Scan cards. Hold each card in front of the camera: every student scanned is marked present.
help.cards.4: Press Mark the rest absent if you only scanned the students who came, then Save. A lost card can be replaced from the student's page.
help.language.title: Language
help.language.1: Press the language icon at the top and choose English, සිංහල or தமிழ்.
help.language.2: Your choice is saved on your account, so it stays the same on your other devices.
